$comment: Hand-maintained, minimal conformance status per runtime — not the full machine-readable report/matrix design in docs/REPOSITORY_SPLIT_AND_SPEC_SYNC.md §5 (cross-repo dispatch, sigstore transparency log), which remains deferred. Updated by an operator when a runtime's own CI is observed green against the pinned spec version below. specVersion here is what each runtime currently claims conformance for — it can lag spec/VERSION between a spec bump and that runtime's own update.

runtimes.name: Python
runtimes.notes: text and html modes fully conformant; markdown mode conformant for dialect="commonmark" only — dialect="mdx" raises POLYTYPO_INVALID_DIALECT (no MDX/JSX parser available for this runtime), a narrower but honest claim rather than a silent mishandling of a dialect it does not support.

runtimes.name: Go
runtimes.notes: text and html modes fully conformant; markdown mode conformant for dialect="commonmark" only (CommonMark plus GFM: tables, strikethrough, task lists, autolink literals) — dialect="mdx" returns POLYTYPO_INVALID_DIALECT (no MDX/JSX parser available for this runtime), the same narrower but honest claim as the Python runtime.
